study_identification_part.si4_title: Microstructural mapping of neural pathways in Alzheimer's disease using macrostructure-informed normative tractometry

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: 提案したマクロ構造情報付きノルムトラクトメトリ（MINT）により、健常群で学習した白質の微細構造とトラクト形状（マクロ構造）の統計的変動を用いて、MCIおよび認知症における異常パターンを沿線（along-tract）で同定・可視化し、従来のDTI指標と比較して解釈性・感度を評価する。

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper explicitly states the number of healthy control subjects used in the TractoInferno pretraining dataset. For the target datasets (ADNI and NIMHANS), healthy controls were also used, but these were split for fine-tuning and testing. The normative model was initially trained on 198 subjects from TractoInferno.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: this pretraining dataset consisted of 198 single-shell dMRI volumes already preprocessed from the publicly available TractoInferno training dataset

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: The paper uses diffusion-weighted MRI (dMRI) and derives diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) metrics. The specific metrics mentioned are fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD), radial diffusivity (RD), and axial diffusivity (AxD). These are standard DTI-derived metrics from single-shell diffusion MRI data.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: After processing dMRI, diffusion tensors were fitted at each voxel using the non-linear least-squares method to produce FA, MD, RD, and AxD scalar maps in the dMRI native space... DTI metrics were projected onto the corresponding bundle in the native space. Each streamline was resampled to 128 equidistant points... with seven input features x, y, z, FA, MD, RD, and AxD.
rci5_imaging_modality.location: Feng2025.pdf.md: Methods / 2.2.2 National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences, lines 97-98; Methods / 2.3.2 Data preparation and training, lines 161-162

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: ADNIとNIMHANSの両方で、MCIおよび認知症で広範なWM微細構造・形状異常が一貫して観察され、特にMDの上昇が顕著で、側頭葉経路や脳梁で強い効果を示した。MAE由来指標は対応するDTI指標と同等の感度で臨床重症度とも関連した。
